message:
fix(tool): close pass-5 enrollment audit gaps

Detect quoted -property: and /property: switches and semicolon-list
reserved overrides in dotnet commands, plus sibling paths built with
Path.Join or joined ../Hexalith.* segments. Add regressions for padded
and multi-line build paths and the pass-4 syntax forms. Document
validate --adoption in the README.
